title: English Practice Quiz 0936
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.
